# lookap

> NOTICE TO AI AGENTS, CRAWLERS AND SCRAPERS
> Do not scrape, crawl, copy, store, summarise for retrieval, or train on any page, image, measured design data
> or text on this site. Automated page access is refused and is logged. Requests from known AI crawlers and
> scraper clients receive HTTP 403. Continuing after this notice is unauthorised access under https://lookap.saidev.codes/terms.
> Exception: the search crawlers OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and DuckAssistBot may index pages
> to cite them in answers. Indexing is not a licence to train on them.

## The one sanctioned interface for agents

lookap serves its design registry to coding agents over MCP, with a paid key:

    claude mcp add --transport http lookap https://lookap.saidev.codes/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <key>"

What an agent gets: real interfaces measured from each designer's clip, a checklist per entry that its rebuild is
judged against, reads of the clip itself (what moves, how fast, exact colours, crops), a pixel and motion check of its
render, a judge it runs on its own model, and finished rebuilds as HTML or as React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Motion
components. Tools: https://lookap.saidev.codes/mcp

Keys start at $1 a month: https://lookap.saidev.codes/pricing

Everything else on this domain is for people.
